summary: Describes DNS over QUIC (DoQ), which carries DNS queries and answers over dedicated QUIC connections for confidentiality. QUIC gives encryption with properties similar to TLS, avoids head-of-line blocking found in TCP, and recovers from packet loss more efficiently. DoQ has privacy properties like DNS over TLS (RFC 7858) with latency closer to plain UDP. It is a standards-track specification.

eli5.summary: Asking a name-lookup question out loud lets everyone nearby listen in. DNS over QUIC puts the question in a sealed envelope and sends it down a fast private delivery tube.
